name: DatePicker range
intro: The React range picker uses DatePicker with selectionMode="range". Render one Control with bound="start" and another with bound="end" inside the same Root. The visible fields use MM/DD/YYYY; callback valueAsString uses ISO YYYY-MM-DD.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Owns the start and end dates.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Receives both endpoint slots as Dates and ISO strings; an unset endpoint stays undefined with an empty ISO string.

parts.name: Control
parts.description: Groups each date input and calendar trigger.

props.name: bound
props.description: Identifies which range endpoint this control edits.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Receives a typed MM/DD/YYYY start or end date. Each field sets aria-invalid for malformed text or a date outside its effective bounds.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Opens the calendar for its Control.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: Place one calendar here for both range inputs.

parts.name: View
parts.description: Shows day, month, or year selection.

parts.name: TableCellTrigger
parts.description: Selects a date in the range.

accessibility: Give the start and end fields distinct visible labels, names, and format hints. An end date cannot precede the start; a start date cannot follow the end. Root min and max further limit both endpoints.
